articles.title: US tells citizens to leave Iran, warns hostilities could escalate fast
articles.description: The US Virtual Embassy in Iran said Tehran, Yemen's Houthis and other aligned groups may target US interests and citizens in the region, including companies and institutions. The alert followed Iranian attacks on US assets in Bahrain and Kuwait and a Houthi strike on Riyadh that injured 11 people.

articles.title: Iran’s strikes push Bahrain toward economic collapse as U.S. military presence backfires
articles.description: Iran’s retaliatory missile and drone strikes against U.S. military installations in Bahrain have caused severe economic damage – with the IMF projecting an 11.3% GDP contraction this year, the steepest in the Gulf region. The attacks exposed a key vulnerability in U.S. strategy: Iran targets the host nation rather than the U.S. directly, damaging Bahraini infrastructure […]
